description: Administration of police affairs and services, including alien registration, issuing work and travel documents to immigrants, maintenance of arrest records and statistics related to police work; regulation and control of road traffic; prevention of smuggling and control of off-shore and ocean fishing; operation of regular and auxiliary police forces.
includes: administration of police affairs and services
operation of regular and auxiliary police forces, port, border and coast guards, and other special police forces maintained by the public authorities
alien registration, work and travel documents for immigrants
regulation and control of road traffic
prevention of smuggling and control of off-shore and ocean fishing
excludes: police colleges offering general education in addition to police training, see 0921 / 0922
